tools.name: skore_agent
tools.description:
Run one turn of the Skore ML methodology and return the next actions.

Call this for anything ML experimentation related, then act as its hands: it
decides what to do, you carry it out in the user's workspace.

Start a turn with `prompt` (the user's request, verbatim). On the first call
in a conversation, omit `session_id` -- do not invent one and do not reuse an
id from another chat. If the result has `status="action_required"`, perform
every action in `actions` locally with your own file, shell, and question
tools, then call this tool again with the same `session_id` from the previous
result and one `results` entry per action -- including for actions that
failed, with the error as the output. Repeat until `status="done"`. After
`done`, call again only when the user has a new request, with that same
`session_id` and a new `prompt`.

Do not restate the actions to the user as advice, and do not substitute your
own plan: the methodology, including when to ask the user for a decision, is
decided here.

items.description: The outcome of one action the client executed locally.

id.description: The `id` of the action this result answers.

output.description: What the action produced: file content, command output, the user's answers, or an error message if it failed.

session_id.description: Pass this back on every follow-up call in this conversation. Do not invent a new id and do not reuse an id from another chat.

message.description: What to relay to the user, possibly empty.

items.description: One step the client must perform in the user's workspace.

tool.description: Canonical name of the action: read_file, write_file, edit_file, run_shell or ask_user. Perform it with your own equivalent local tool, whatever it is called.
